name: elder-scrolls-vi-sentinel-report
lines:
حسب ذا فيرج (The Verge)
تدور الأحداث في Hammerfell

وقد يُكشف الاسم رسميًا
الشهر المقبل

لا عرض للعب مع الاسم،
ولم تعلّق بيثيسدا (Bethesda)
headline:
اسم The Elder Scrolls VI
قد يكون Sentinel
label: تقرير
note: Report: The Verge (Tom Warren, Notepad, 29 Oct 2026, via Kotaku 16:16Z and GamesRadar 16:29Z): subtitle Sentinel, Hammerfell, title reveal as soon as November, only the title; Bethesda and Microsoft have not confirmed. Footage: Bethesda's Skyrim Special Edition trailer (Steam app 489830, 1080p 5.7 Mbps, decode clean), stand-in, credited on screen; the only TES VI footage is the 2018 teaser on YouTube. Track: the trailer's own music from 4.0 s. The M rating (0-3 s) and the comparison labels at the right edge sit outside the 9:16 window. v2 (director FIX on v1): focus pinned left of the comparison labels (v1 autofocus slid right and showed NEW WATER SHADERS and REMASTERED cut at the bottom); dragon shot ends 25.6 s, clear of the SKYRIM title card.
